summary: Bismarck uses total connected electrical load or designed capacity: micro is 100 kW or less; minor is greater than 100 kW through 6 MW inclusive; major is over 6 MW. Accessory data processing at another principal use is excluded from the primary facility definition.

summary: A facility or group must meet all statutory tests, including equipment use and common or affiliated ownership, operation or leasing; aggregate critical IT load of at least 90 MW; and in-service date on or after July 1, 2025. summary: State law preempts county and municipal zoning, noise, viewshed, lighting, development or land-use restrictions and approvals for certified microgrid districts and certified high-impact data centers. Do not apply this to an uncertified facility based on size alone.

summary: Metro suspended acceptance and further processing by its named planning and zoning bodies of rezoning, conditional-use and Plan Certain Category 2B/3 applications proposing telecommunications hotels or data centers.
